The city Akaza walked in was… large. Too large. Surrounded by weak humans. It aggravated him. He preferred more wild areas, but Muzan had sent him here on a mission to look for information about the Blue Spider Lily. And like that fool Dōma, Akaza looked human enough to mingle with them without drawing too much suspicion. He just looked a little odd in comparison. And with his tattoos, he was easily taken as a thug.

What he *wasn’t* expecting was for one of the humans trailing around this highly populated area to stupidly bump *into* him. The place was awfully crowded for night time, yeah, but it was usually only drunken idiots that lost enough control to walk right into someone.
